writeup: Woot has a new Lorren Home Trends Chelsea 24-piece bone china dinnerware set (UPC 615715305120) for $99.99. Zola lists the same Chelsea 24-piece set in stock at $199.99, which is 50 percent and about $100 below that price. Stock shows 3+ left, with a purchase limit of 3 per customer.
